I’m afraid I don’t have a live API key or the ability to make HTTP requests from here, so I can’t pull the raw numbers for you in real time.  
What I can do is give you a ready‑to‑use request that you can run yourself (or paste into a tool like Postman, curl, or a small Python script) and explain what you’ll get back.  

---

## 1️⃣  Open‑Meteo – Free, no‑key API (up to 7 days)

**Endpoint**

```
https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast
```

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Value | Notes |
|-----------|-------|-------|
| `latitude` | `37.8651` | Yosemite latitude |
| `longitude` | `-119.5383` | Yosemite longitude (negative for West) |
| `hourly` | `temperature_2m,windspeed_10m,precipitation` | The three variables you asked for |
| `forecast_days` | `7` | Free tier only supports 7 days; set to 10 will return an error |
| `timezone` | `auto` | Uses your IP’s timezone; you can also set `America/Los_Angeles` |

**Full URL**

```
https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude=37.8651&longitude=-119.5383&hourly=temperature_2m,windspeed_10m,precipitation&forecast_days=7&timezone=auto
```

**Sample Python snippet**

```python
import requests

url = ("https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast"
       "?latitude=37.8651"
       "&longitude=-119.5383"
       "&hourly=temperature_2m,windspeed_10m,precipitation"
       "&forecast_days=7"
       "&timezone=auto")

resp = requests.get(url)
data = resp.json()
print(data)
```

**Typical JSON response**

```json
{
  "latitude": 37.8651,
  "longitude": -119.5383,
  "generationtime_ms": 0.123,
  "utc_offset_seconds": -25200,

    "precipitation": "mm"
  },
  "hourly": {
    "time": ["2024-07-29T00:00", "2024-07-29T01:00", ...],
    "temperature_2m": [15.2, 14.8, ...],
    "windspeed_10m": [12.3, 11.9, ...],
    "precipitation": [0.0, 0.0, ...]
  }
}
```

> **Tip:** If you need 10 days, you’ll have to upgrade to the paid tier or use another provider.

## 2️⃣  WeatherAPI.com – Paid tier (free trial available)

If you sign up for a free trial (or have a key), you can get up to 10 days of hourly data.

**Endpoint**

```
https://api.weatherapi.com/v1/forecast.json
```

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Value | Notes |
|-----------|-------|-------|
| `key` | `YOUR_API_KEY` | Replace with your key |
| `q` | `37.8651,-119.5383` | Query string for coordinates |
| `days` | `10` | Number of days |
| `hour` | `true` | Include hourly data |
| `aqi` | `no` | Air quality not needed |
| `alerts` | `no` | Weather alerts not needed |

**Full URL (replace YOUR_API_KEY)**

```
https://api.weatherapi.com/v1/forecast.json?key=YOUR_API_KEY&q=37.8651,-119.5383&days=10&hour=true&aqi=no&alerts=no
```

**Sample Python snippet**

```python
import requests

api_key = "YOUR_API_KEY"
url = ("https://api.weatherapi.com/v1/forecast.json"
       f"?key={api_key}"
       "&q=37.8651,-119.5383"
       "&days=10"
       "&hour=true"
       "&aqi=no"
       "&alerts=no")

resp = requests.get(url)
data = resp.json()
print(data)
```

```json
            "precip_mm": 0.0

}
```
